messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments"
set: ["your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments", "treatment may include diet", "treatment may include exercise", "your treatment may include a special diet", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests", "treatment may include blood tests", "treatment may include weight control", "other pain treatments", "counseling", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, medical tests, and special medical care", "other treatments have not worked", "cannot tolerate other pain treatments", "dose adjustments or alternative treatments may be available", "other pain treatments do not treat your pain well enough", "people with asthma or other breathing problems only when other treatments are not suitable", "include rifampin"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
